name: preview-overlay-button
description: Studio-specific dev affordance. The Tweaks panel can't open Panels/Modals — it only flips state values. To let the user preview an overlay without clicking a real row-level button, add a small 'Preview: …' Button inside the card's visible content (typically at the bottom) whose `overlay` prop points at the same Panel/Modal node the real trigger uses. Keeps visual fidelity honest in the preview without polluting the production card design.
